summary.text: Lydia Edwards is a Democratic state senator who represents the 3rd Suffolk District and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An attorney, she previously served on the Boston City Council, representing District 1 from 2018 to 2022.

paragraphs.text: Lydia Edwards earned a B.A. in political science and legal policy studies from Fordham University in 2003, a J.D. from American University in 2006, and an LL.M. in taxation from Boston University in 2015.

Her career experience includes work as counsel with Jason Wiener P.C., as deputy director of the Boston office of housing stability, and as a Massachusetts campaign coordinator with the National Domestic Workers Alliance.
Edwards represented District 1 on the Boston City Council from 2018 to 2022; Gabriela Coletta Zapata succeeded her there.

In the 2025-2026 Senate session she chairs the Judiciary Joint Committee, is vice chair of the Housing Joint Committee, and serves on the Senate Ways and Means Committee and the Transportation Joint Committee, among others.
